headline: Trump won spending promises from NATO last year. This week, he'll try to enforce them
context: President Donald Trump is heading to Ankara, Turkey, for the annual NATO summit. Last year, he pushed NATO allies to spend more on defense. This year, his mission is to try to enforce those pledges.
